revenue.definition: SUM(NetAmount) on Power BI sales reports; SUM(SaleNetAmount) on dbo.VwAISalesData
revenue.description: Total sales value from net amount
revenue.strict_rule: Use NetAmount on VW_MB_POWERBI_SLS_* views and SaleNetAmount on dbo.VwAISalesData—pick the column that exists in your chosen view. Never use MRP or before-tax fields for revenue unless the user explicitly asks.

dead_stock.definition: Items with StockQty > 0 and no sales in last 90 days

top_supplier.definition: Top supplier by SUM(PurCost) or purchase amount
top_supplier.description: Highest contributing supplier in selected period

top_customer.description: Highest customer contribution in selected period

branch_performance.definition: SUM(NetAmount) grouped by BranchName or BranchId (only use columns listed in schema for the chosen view)
